# Runner capacity action maintenance

Keep reclamation limited to the fixed hosted Linux toolchain paths in [action.yml](action.yml). Preserve filesystem-bounded deletion, retained-path diagnostics, free-space reporting, and the 10 GiB warning threshold. Do not apply this destructive preparation to arbitrary or developer-owned runners. Capacity preparation is not acceptance evidence.

Maintain this local documentation pair; see [README.md](README.md) and the [parent action contract](../AGENTS.md).
